what: B holds Bo's note P and his signed edit V of it, and an unsigned note U under Ada's id and seq that also names P. A holds Ada's signed case at that seq and the same unsigned note U. Merging A into B places the signed case first: it outranks U in another table, U is removed and reported in rejected, and P stays superseded, since V still names it. Then A's copy of U, unsigned, collides with the signed case and is refused: nothing is counted a duplicate.
